read: 37 addresses held kUSDT on saturday 21 november, 6 days after the token's genesis on 15 november, after 14 holders on 16 november, in our own node count. across all 455 KCC-20 tokens 2,126 addresses held at least one on 21 november, 197 more than the 1,929 on 14 november. the close fell 3.53% from saturday 14 november to saturday 21 november, the fourth falling week in a row, to $0.02544, the lowest weekly close in our series of 104 weeks since 24 november 2024. it sits 25.21% below the 50 week average on 21 november, after 23.63% below it on 14 november. the 50 week line sits at $0.034017 and the 21 week line at $0.032859, source kraken, week to 21 november.
